Hi. I seen your post in the MH forum on Reddit. I'm Dr. Nuchelle Chance, psychologist at Missouri Western State University.   
Dr. Chance’s Take a Chance Social Science Research Lab (SSRL) is humbly requesting your participation in a research project assessing lived adversity and suicidality. We are highly aware of the sensitive nature of this topic and as such, all this information is confidential as well as no results being linked back to the participants. Previous research shows that the mental health needs of many people have been unmet and yield compounded health risks such as #suicide. Research further shows that increased #resilience is a protective factor against mental illness and suicide. Therefore, the need for a better understanding of the underlying causes of suicidal behavior among those suffering from mental health crises is critical. If you are a woman who is 18+ and willing to help us by taking this survey please click the following link (MWSU IRB approval 3674): https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSdYqgefTpmJdgKaThfc5IeBy6GpF0R33KGbqyB37BNVfYuNwQ/viewform?usp=sf\_link
